Labels.DropActorsHere: Drop actors here to add them to the party

MakeCharacterDefault.Name: Use compact sheet as the default character sheet
MakeCharacterDefault.Hint: When enabled, player characters open with the compact sheet by default. Reload after changing this setting.

MakeAdversaryDefault.Name: Use compact sheet as the default adversary sheet
MakeAdversaryDefault.Hint: When enabled, adversary actors open with the compact sheet by default. Reload after changing this setting.

MakeEnvironmentDefault.Name: Use compact sheet as the default environment sheet
MakeEnvironmentDefault.Hint: When enabled, environment actors open with the compact sheet by default. Reload after changing this setting.

MakeNpcDefault.Name: Use compact sheet as the default NPC sheet
MakeNpcDefault.Hint: When enabled, NPC actors open with the compact sheet by default. Reload after changing this setting.

MakePartyDefault.Name: Use compact sheet as the default party sheet
MakePartyDefault.Hint: When enabled, party actors open with the compact sheet by default. Reload after changing this setting.

ShowAdversaryInteractionButtons.Name: Show interaction buttons on compact adversary, environment, and NPC sheets
ShowAdversaryInteractionButtons.Hint: When enabled, compact adversary, environment, and NPC sheets show attack, chat, item action, and similar interaction controls.

ShowSourceAndArtist.Name: Show source and artist on compact sheets
ShowSourceAndArtist.Hint: When enabled, compact adversary, environment, and NPC sheets show their source and artist at the bottom of the sheet.

ShowAdversaryResourceBlock.Name: Show a separate HP and stress block on compact adversary sheets
ShowAdversaryResourceBlock.Hint: When enabled, compact adversary sheets show HP, stress, and damage thresholds in a separate footer block. When disabled, the resource block is hidden and those values move into the header summary.
